claims.text: Persistent allergic rhinitis: an alternative to intranasal glucocorticoids, alone or combined with one
claims.quote: The treatment of persistent rhinitis is preferably with intranasal glucocorticoids, however, intranasal antihistamines or their combination (ie, intranasal glucocorticoids plus intranasal antihistamines) are alternatives.

claims.text: Combination sprays: azelastine/fluticasone (137 mcg/50 mcg), olopatadine/mometasone (665 mcg/25 mcg)
claims.quote: Combinations of azelastine/fluticasone (137 mcg/50 mcg) and olopatadine/mometasone (665 mcg/25 mcg) may be used.

claims.text: Vasomotor rhinitis: olopatadine or azelastine 1 spray BID may be of some benefit
claims.quote: Topical glucocorticoids (eg, mometasone 2 sprays twice a day) and nasal antihistamines (eg, olopatadine and azelastine 1 spray twice a day) can also be of some benefit.
